name: Echoform Dry Kill - Wet Only Mix
description: Validates dry kill removes dry signal from output while continuing normal buffer operation (unlike wipe). Buffer should continue writing.

capability_requirements.notes: Tests dry kill: removes dry signal but maintains buffer writes

wet_signal_present.description: Wet signal should be present (dry killed but wet active)

feedback_active.description: Feedback should create temporal variation (buffer is being written)

sustained_energy.description: Energy should be sustained by feedback (unlike wipe, buffer is active)

use_cases: Verify dry kill removes dry signal from mix
Test buffer continues writing (unlike wipe mode)
Validate feedback remains active with dry kill
Ensure wet-only output without stopping DSP
pass_criteria: Wet-only output with active feedback and buffer writing
example_failures: Dry signal present → dry kill not working
No feedback → buffer not being written
Behaves like wipe → confusion between dry kill and wipe
